prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. Over everything lies the fine engraved line work of a banknote: thousands of hair-thin curving parallel lines and rosettes printed in money-green and copper ink, wrapping round the contours of the face, the hat brim, the bricks and the cigarette smoke like a contour map, so the real scene looks printed on a dollar bill. Camera close at chest height, slightly below: a heavy-set gangster in a chalk-stripe suit and grey fedora, with a broad pockmarked face and a flattened boxer's nose, leans his mouth to the slot of a plain steel door, his face large and right of centre; through the slot, two wary eyes. Light: one bare bulb above the door; most of the frame in deep shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
